mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.parent_seq AS parentSeq, u.admin_name AS authorName, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN c.user_seq = #{userSeq} THEN true ELSE false END AS isMine FROM comment c JOIN admin_user u ON c.user_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.domain_type = #{domainType} AND c.ref_id = #{refId} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.parent_seq IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.parent_seq AS parentSeq, u.admin_name AS authorName, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN c.user_seq = #{userSeq} THEN true ELSE false END AS isMine FROM comment c JOIN admin_user u ON c.user_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.parent_seq = #{parentSeq} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
